corpus.network: Undirected positive normalized pointwise mutual information, disjoint ~150-word windows; >=8 co-windows and >=4 talks; display cutoff .08. Co-occurrence is not causation, sequence, or agreement.
corpus.coverage: A term family appears in at least two distinct transcript segments per talk. Categories overlap. The network also requires both concepts to meet this talk-level coverage rule.
corpus.topics: Exploratory non-negative matrix factorization at k=6,8,10, three seeds. Report k=6 as a broad view. k=8 has higher seed stability here but also a weak component led by a partial recording. This is not a true topic count; partial talks can create weak components at higher k.
corpus.similarity: 16-dimensional latent semantic analysis on unigram TF-IDF, cosine similarity. Suggestions require editorial review.
corpus.sentiment: General-purpose VADER on transcript segments of >=8 words. Threshold ±.05 and sensitivity ±.5. No audio, audience reaction, or target-specific stance.
corpus.scope: Clip boundaries can retain brief introductions within talks. The two captured main-stage feeds and recorded inserts; not the full multi-room event. Master ASR text, not written summaries or speaker bios. Names and numerical claims can contain transcription errors.
